cleanup_code: system('taskkill /F /IM "AppRoadRunner.exe" >nul 2>&1'); pause(3); bdclose('all'); clear all; close all; home;

evals.name: Connect Status and Version Without Launching
evals.description: Tests connection to a running instance, status reporting, and version check without launching
evals.prompt: Connect to RoadRunner and tell me the current status — what project, scene, and scenario are open? Also report the RoadRunner version.

context.setup: RoadRunner must be running with a project open

evals.name: Save Scene As Then Create New Scene with Guard
evals.description: Tests save scene with new name and new scene creation with strlength guard and handle invalidation
evals.prompt: Save my current scene as HighwayV2 and then create a brand new blank scene. Be careful not to lose any unsaved work.

context.setup: RoadRunner must be running with a scene open

assertions.description: Saves scene with new name using saveScene
Clears full handle list after new scene
assertions.expected: clear rrApi rrScene rrProject rrs phaseLogic

evals.name: New Scenario with Unsaved Scenario Guard
evals.description: Tests new scenario creation with the multi-condition unsaved-work guard pattern
evals.prompt: Connect to RoadRunner and create a new blank scenario. Be careful not to lose any unsaved work.

context.setup: RoadRunner must be running with a scenario open

assertions.description: Uses combined isempty AND isstruct guard for scenario
Checks UnsavedChanges on Scenario after struct check
Saves scenario if unsaved before creating new

evals.name: Open Project and Scene with Guards
evals.description: Tests opening a project with folder check, then opening a scene with handle invalidation
evals.prompt: Open my RoadRunner project at C:/Temp/RoadRunnerEvals/TestProject, then open the ScenarioBasic scene. Make sure nothing is lost.

context.setup: RoadRunner must be running. The project and scene must exist.

assertions.description: Checks project folder exists with isfolder
Clears full handle list after state changes
assertions.expected: clear rrApi rrScene rrProject rrs phaseLogic

evals.name: Open Scenario with Unsaved Guard
evals.description: Tests opening a scenario with isstruct guard and handle invalidation
evals.prompt: Open the FreeDrive scenario in RoadRunner. Make sure nothing is lost if a scenario is already open.

context.setup: RoadRunner must be running with a project and scene open

assertions.description: Checks isstruct on Scenario before accessing UnsavedChanges

evals.name: Create New Project with Guards and Handle Scene Not Found
evals.description: Tests project creation with folder guards, then error recovery when a scene is not found
evals.prompt: Create a new RoadRunner project at C:/Temp/RoadRunnerEvals/NewProject, then try to open a scene called NonExistentScene. If it doesn't exist, show me what scenes are available.

context.setup: RoadRunner must be running. The target folder must NOT already exist.

assertions.description: Calls newProject with rrApp and path
Lists scenes using dir with rrscene pattern
Uses the Scenes folder from project path
